findings.summary: Policy evidence and project memory have a pure mapper but no composed authorized read/publication route.

evidence.observation: createSfEvidenceRouter has no policy branch; all policy refs fall through to unavailable.
emitFromLedger requires case-event; recall accepts a case and validates task records only.
WP14 defines project mapping from AuthorizedPolicyProjection, but no WP10 composition invokes this branch.
Text acknowledges missing policy/project proofs; missing producer/composition should also be explicit.

static_reproduction: Take a schema-valid BusinessEvidenceRef of kind policy in the same installation/project and a currently authorized call.
Route it through the composed BCS evidence router: no matching policy branch exists, so it returns unavailable.
There is no host projectSlab or authorized policy emit/recall entry in the inspected host-binding and CLI composition roots. Pure mapSfAtlasEntry({kind:project}) is not runtime composition.
findings.impact: Reviewed procedures cannot be persisted/recalled through the composed project memory lane; a C17 complete/AM05 acceptance would omit approved scope. Existing behavior fails closed rather than granting invented authority.
findings.required_action: Wire only an actual reviewed policy producer and current authorization/owner/scope, durable project publication and retrieval; otherwise list implementation and native evidence as blocked dependencies. Do not substitute a fabricated provider, source or policy.
